dialogdefinitions.name: ac3select
dialogdefinitions.title: Audio Bitrate Selection
dialogdefinitions.description: Please select audio bitrate for AC3 encoding

dialogdefinitions.name: audiobitrate
dialogdefinitions.title: Audio Bitrate Selection
dialogdefinitions.description: Please select audio bitrate for lossy audio encoding

dialogdefinitions.name: audiostreamselect
dialogdefinitions.title: Audio Stream Selection
dialogdefinitions.description: Please select which audio stream to use for encoding

dialogdefinitions.name: quality
dialogdefinitions.title: Audio Quality Selection
dialogdefinitions.description: Please select audio quality for variable bitrate encoding (lower is better quality)

presets.name: alac
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossless ALAC format. If the input file is a video, the audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: flac
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossless FLAC format. If the input file is a video, the audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: wavpack
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossless WAVPACK format. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: cd-wav
presets.description: Encodes an input file to uncompressed PCM WAV format (CD quality). If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: dvd-wav
presets.description: Encodes an input file to uncompressed PCM WAV format (DVD quality). If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: wav-16bit
presets.description: Encodes an input file to uncompressed PCM WAV format with 16-bit samples. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: wav-24bit
presets.description: Encodes an input file to uncompressed PCM WAV format with 24-bit samples. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: wav-float
presets.description: Encodes an input file to uncompressed PCM WAV format with 32-bit float samples. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: mp3-bitrate
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy MP3 format at 320kbps. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: mp3-vbr
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy MP3 format with variable bitrate quality. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only. quality is selectable before encoding.

presets.name: m4a-bitrate
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy AAC format based on bitrate. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only. Bitrate is selectable before encoding.

presets.name: m4a-vbr
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy AAC format based on variable bitrate quality. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only. Quality is selectable before encoding.

presets.name: ac3
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy AC3 format. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only. Bitrate is selectable before encoding.

presets.name: wma
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy WMA 1.0 format. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only. Bitrate is selectable before encoding.

presets.name: wma2
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy WMA 2.0 format. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only. Bitrate is selectable before encoding.

presets.name: weba-opus-128k
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy Opus format at 128kbps. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: weba-opus-192k
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy Opus format at 192kbps. If the input file is a video, the 1st audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: weba-vorbits
presets.description: Encodes an input file to lossy Vorbits format with variable bitrate quality 6. If the input file is a video, the audio stream is extracted only.

presets.name: remux-mkv
presets.description: Remuxes an input video file to MKV container without re-encoding.

presets.name: h264-mp4
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to H.264 format in an MP4 container using Nvidia hardware acceleration.

presets.name: h265-mp4
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to H.265 format in an MP4 container using Nvidia hardware acceleration.

presets.name: ntsc-4:3-ac3
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to DVD compliant MPEG-2 format for NTSC 4:3 DVDs. Audio is encoded to AC3 format at 448kbps. Vido bitrate varies between 6000-9000kbps.

presets.name: ntsc-16:9-ac3
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to DVD compliant MPEG-2 format for NTSC 4:3 DVDs. Audio is encoded to AC3 format at 448kbps. Vido bitrate varies between 6000-9000kbps.

presets.name: pal-4:3-ac3
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to DVD compliant MPEG-2 format for PAL 4:3 DVDs.  Audio is encoded to AC3 format at 448kbps. Vido bitrate varies between 6000-9000kbps.

presets.name: pal-16:9-ac3
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to DVD compliant MPEG-2 format for PAL 4:3 DVDs.  Audio is encoded to AC3 format at 448kbps. Vido bitrate varies between 6000-9000kbps.

presets.name: pal
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to SVCD compliant MPEG-2 format for PAL SVCDs. Audio is encoded to MP2 format at 224kbps. Vido bitrate varies between 2440-2516kbps.

presets.name: ntsc
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to SVCD compliant MPEG-2 format for NTSC SVCDs. Audio is encoded to MP2 format at 224kbps. Vido bitrate varies between 2440-2516kbps.

presets.name: pal-letterbox
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to SVCD compliant MPEG-2 format for PAL SVCDs with letterboxing for 16:9 aspect ratio. Audio is encoded to MP2 format at 224kbps. Vido bitrate varies between 2440-2516kbps.

presets.name: ntsc-letterbox
presets.description: Encodes an input video file to SVCD compliant MPEG-2 format for NTSC SVCDs with letterboxing for 16:9 aspect ratio. Audio is encoded to MP2 format at 224kbps. Vido bitrate varies between 2440-2516kbps.
